synopsis_ppt_objective: Geostationary Satellite Ingestion: Ingest half-hourly thermal infrared (TIR) imagery (INSAT-3DR / NASA MERGIR equivalent) to monitor cloud-top brightness temperatures and convective cloud dynamics over Meghalaya.
current_implementation: Ingested 2,352 half-hourly NASA MERGIR 4km IR Brightness Temperature (Tb) granules across 49 monsoon days (2023, 2024, 2025) plus 6 INSAT-3DR L1C HDF5 sample frames with validated LUT calibration.
dataset_used: NASA GPM MERGIR V1 (10.7 um IR Tb) & ISRO INSAT-3DR L1C ASIA_MER
remaining_action: None for academic submission. Operational prospective deployment would connect to IMD/MOSDAC live FTP stream.

synopsis_ppt_objective: Satellite Precipitation Ingestion: Acquire high-resolution satellite precipitation estimates from NASA GPM IMERG to serve as ground-truth proxy and antecedent rainfall histories.
current_implementation: Ingested 2,352 half-hourly NASA GPM IMERG V07B Final Run NetCDF4 files (0.1 degree resolution) with authentic mm/hr rates, strict QC validity masks, and no synthetic proxies.
dataset_used: NASA GPM IMERG V07B Final Run (Half-Hourly)
remaining_action: None. Retrospective research uses IMERG Final Run; operational near-real-time would use IMERG Early Run (~4h latency).

synopsis_ppt_objective: Meteorological Spatial-Temporal Alignment: Align disparate satellite grids onto a common georeferenced spatial mesh and strict chronological timeline.
current_implementation: Constructed 25x40 common grid (0.10 deg, [24.5, 27.0]N, [89.5, 93.5]E) covering Meghalaya with synoptic buffer. Implemented conservative interpolation and strict temporal causal indexing.
dataset_used: NASA MERGIR IR (4km) + NASA IMERG (0.1 deg)
remaining_action: None. Common grid is frozen and shared across all models and frontend.

synopsis_ppt_objective: Meteorological Baseline Nowcasting: Implement standard literature baselines including Eulerian Persistence and Optical Flow motion tracking.
current_implementation: Implemented Eulerian Persistence, Sparse Lucas-Kanade Optical Flow (with corner detection), and Dense Horn-Schunck Variational Optical Flow with semi-Lagrangian backward advection.
dataset_used: NASA IMERG precipitation and MERGIR IR sequence grids
trained_model_output_artifact: src/models/baselines.py (algorithmic inference in API and evaluation harnesses)

synopsis_ppt_objective: Deep Spatiotemporal Weather Nowcasting (+30m to +180m): Develop deep learning architectures (ConvLSTM, FC-LSTM, MLP) to model cloud convective initiation, growth, and dissipation.
current_implementation: Implemented and trained Canonical MultiTaskWeatherConvLSTM (161,034 params), MultiTaskWeatherFCLSTM (5,048,848 params), and MultiTaskWeatherMLP (13,290 params) across 5 lead horizons.
dataset_used: 38 training days (1,764 sequences), 1 validation day (33 sequences), evaluated on 3 unseen test days (129 sequences, July 12-14, 2023)
verification_evidence: outputs/experiments/PHASE3_TEST_PREDICTIONS/PHASE3_TEST_PREDICTIONS_2023.npz, outputs/reports/PHASE3_COMPLETION.md (ConvLSTM 30m CSI=0.5611, ROC-AUC=0.9851, QPF RMSE=0.7478 mm/hr)

synopsis_ppt_objective: Extended 6-Hour (+360m) Nowcasting Horizon: Evaluate skill degradation up to 6 hours (+360 minutes) to establish the observational limit of extrapolation.
current_implementation: Evaluated all 7 weather models at +360m (12 half-hourly advection steps). Confirmed physical predictability ceiling where CSI drops to 0.0000 to 0.0564 as convective cells dissipate without thermodynamic NWP forcing.
dataset_used: July 12-14, 2023 holdout test set (N=129,000 spatial cells at +360m)
verification_evidence: Recomputed metrics show CSI drops to 0.0000 (ConvLSTM), 0.0227 (Dense OF), 0.0564 (Persistence) at +360m; API displays explicit physical limit notice.
remaining_action: None. Limitation is scientifically explained and defended in dissertation.

synopsis_ppt_objective: Multi-Task Weather Outputs: Predict both categorical convective hazard probabilities (exceeding heavy rain thresholds) and continuous Quantitative Precipitation Forecasts (QPF in mm/hr).
current_implementation: ConvLSTM, FC-LSTM, and MLP incorporate dual task heads: sigmoid cross-entropy classification head (threshold >= 5.0 mm/hr) and Softplus MSE regression head (continuous mm/hr rate).
dataset_used: Normalized multimodal tensors: IR Tb + IMERG rate + sensor validity mask

synopsis_ppt_objective: Topographic Feature Engineering: Derive continuous morphometric indices (elevation, slope, aspect, curvature, ruggedness) from authoritative DEM for geomorphic hazard modeling.
current_implementation: Extracted 10 continuous terrain derivatives from 90m NASA SRTM GL1 DEM: Elevation, Mean Slope, Max Slope, Relief, Slope Std, Aspect Northness, Aspect Eastness, Curvature, TRI, and TPI.
dataset_used: USGS / NASA SRTM 1 Arc-Second Global DEM (30m downsampled to 90m)

synopsis_ppt_objective: Landslide Inventory Curation: Curate an authentic historical landslide event inventory for Meghalaya with verified coordinates, triggers, and dates.
current_implementation: Audited 67 raw NASA Global Landslide Catalog (GLC/COOLR) events. Excluded 25 cross-border events outside Meghalaya and 4 non-rainfall triggers (mining/quarry). Retained 38 verified rainfall-triggered events.
dataset_used: NASA Global Landslide Catalog (GLC/COOLR) & William & Mary geoBoundaries ADM1
verification_evidence: tests/test_phase4_landslide_models.py (38 events strictly inside Meghalaya boundary polygon)

synopsis_ppt_objective: Static Landslide Susceptibility Mapping (LSM): Train machine learning classifiers (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost) using spatial cross-validation to generate regional susceptibility maps.
current_implementation: Trained L2-Logistic Regression, Random Forest (100 trees), and XGBoost (100 trees) under 3-fold leave-one-block-out spatial CV (West Garo, Central Khasi, East Jaintia). Precomputed and serve 90m susceptibility rasters.
dataset_used: 10 SRTM morphometric features on 38 presences + 190 spatially buffered pseudo-absences
verification_evidence: outputs/experiments/PHASE4_SPATIAL_CV_RESULTS.csv, outputs/reports/PHASE5_SCIENTIFIC_CORRECTIONS.md (Disclosed symmetric AUC ~0.5913 vs asymmetric scarp-max AUC ~0.9623)
remaining_action: None. Scientific sampling nuances fully documented.

synopsis_ppt_objective: Dynamic Rainfall-Triggered Landslide Hazard: Couple static susceptibility with antecedent rainfall histories to estimate situational landslide hazard.
current_implementation: Implemented dynamic hazard progression matrix coupling static LSI with NASA IMERG 7-day weighted antecedent rainfall index (0.6 * P24h + 0.4 * P72h), producing dynamic hazard tiers (Levels 0-3: Very Low, Low, Moderate, High).
dataset_used: NASA IMERG half-hourly rainfall + Static LSI raster
remaining_action: None. Explicitly disclosed as empirical advisory tiers, not calibrated occurrence probability.

synopsis_ppt_objective: Supervised Next-24-Hour Landslide Event Forecasting (GRU/MLP): Train end-to-end temporal deep learning models to predict next-calendar-day failure occurrence at specific slope units.
current_implementation: Audited temporal feasibility. Proved that supervised hourly/daily sequence modeling is empirically blocked: historical landslides span 2007-2019 (date-only precision), weather cubes span 2023-2025 (zero overlap), extreme rarity (8.01e-6 prevalence), and absence ambiguity.
verification_evidence: outputs/reports/PHASE4_NEXT24H_FEASIBILITY.md (Mathematical and empirical proof of data blockage; retained defensible static LSI + dynamic antecedent hazard)
remaining_action: Documented as a formal research limitation for the dissertation; requires future real-time landslide sensor networks.

synopsis_ppt_objective: Full-Stack Web GIS Application: Build an interactive geospatial dashboard using Leaflet and FastAPI to visualize weather nowcasts, susceptibility layers, dynamic alerts, and event records.
current_implementation: Implemented FastAPI backend serving all 7 weather and 3 landslide models, dynamic hazard series, boundary vectors, and metadata. Built responsive Leaflet frontend with time slider, lead selector, calibration toggle, and inspection cards.
dataset_used: Retrospective research archives: July 1-7, 2025 (336 timesteps), 90m SRTM terrain, 38 GLC events
trained_model_output_artifact: Interactive web application accessible at http://127.0.0.1:8000/
verification_evidence: outputs/reports/PHASE5_APPLICATION_TEST_RESULTS.csv (18/18 PASS), outputs/figures/phase5/fig01 to fig04 (headless Chrome screenshots)

synopsis_ppt_objective: Scientific Validation, Leakage Prevention & Anti-Fallacy Warnings: Enforce strict chronological split boundaries, prevent target leakage, and present co-located risks responsibly without uncalibrated joint probabilities.
current_implementation: Enforced 24h synoptic buffers isolating train, val, and test periods. Disclosed retrospective research status; implemented prominent co-location banner warning that overlapping weather and susceptibility does NOT constitute a joint probability.
dataset_used: All project data partitions and layers
